public_rationale: A report published February 23, 2026 attributes a machine-checked CertiCoq ANF correctness proof to Claude Code, with human guidance and an existing CPS proof as a template. The ANF verification had previously been left as future work. [e1] This supplies a documented counterexample when unique means substantive task-specific functionality: the artifact verifies a transformation that its template did not verify. [e1] Lattner's February 18 assessment found no novel ideas in a separate Claude-built C compiler; that finding concerns that implementation. [e2]
limitations: The counterexample is verification code within an existing project, not a complete commercial application or evidence of a newly invented proof technique. [e1]

Claude Code's contribution is attributed by the researcher. Source history cannot conclusively establish AI authorship, and the packet establishes no independent reproduction of the generation process. [e1]
